notes.title: New CG added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184429/1ad688af93e88bdda4f45124a3b674bc16049c09.png[/img]

Several changes have been made right before the official release:

1. New CG added. 
2. Translation updated. The English and Japanese translation has been improved.
3. "Adult Mode" configuration added. You can now turn off adult mode and go live streaming.

Hope you like it!

notes.title: Giant enemies incoming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184429/c21df3176a0a6b6cc9bd5171b68d45eef28592d6.png[/img]
Behold! Giant enemies are now added to the game!
Good luck!

notes.title: Card system updated!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184429/38e9c51dd47ceba2e98ece827b011bc35dafbc27.png[/img]
The card system has been updated. You will no longer pick the card randomly... instead, you can select what card to equip by your will! 
Try your best and kill challenging enemies inside the game and gain more cash! You'll need cash to purchase powerful cards!

notes.title: New character added!
notes.content:
Apologized for missing the release date. There is a restriction to the game store page that it should be published two weeks before the official release. I'm not aware of that and the release date was locked so I have to send Steam an email to see if they can help me change that release date.

The good news is, during this waiting period, two extra characters are added to the game. Also, there are extra enemies and levels as well. Hope you like it!
